brief.headline: S&P 500 edges lower amid broad selloff and sharp single-stock anomalies

stance.label: Cautious / Neutral
stance.summary: Market regime is CAUTIOUS / NEUTRAL at 49/100, with SPY falling 0.4% and broad sector participation negative.

overview.text: SPY fell 0.4% while QQQ was unchanged and IWM rose 0.2%, indicating mixed index performance.
Breadth was weak: only 34.9% of S&P 500 members advanced, with a breadth score of 24/100 and Broad Selloff participation.
Several stocks experienced extreme volatility shocks, including FICO down 16.7% and LULU down 17.4%.
